summary: Ayotte framed Israel as a key U.S. ally during a 2014 congressional visit and, as governor, condemned University of New Hampshire pro-Palestinian chants as 'antisemitic' in April 2024, declaring she is 'proud to stand with Israel' and will 'always support our Jewish community.' Her language equates Palestinian solidarity expression with antisemitism and pledges unwavering alignment with Israel.
